item.tib: dpal gsang bdag gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu skor gyi gzhung
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i bdag nyid/ sde brgyad zil gyis gnon pa'i lha mchog rgyal bsen ma lus 'dul ba'i gnyen po/ byad dang rbod gtong zlog pa'i rgyal po/ mi mthun rgud tshogs zhi ba'i khro rgyal/ dpal gsang bdag gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs sgrub pa'i las tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang nas/ nang sgrub gab pa dgu skor 'di nyid sa steng gi skyes bu mtshan brjod par dka' ba gsang chen rig pa 'dzin pa'i grub thob/ dus ngan bskal khug gso ba'i rnal 'byor/ lta ba yang rtse phyin pa'i rtogs ldan/ sprul pa'i gter chen gshen chen klu dga' de nyid kyi rol gar sbas pa'i tshul 'chang 'du shes sum ldan rim gnyis gyi rnal 'byor kun dga' dbang ldan gyi snyan rgyud dri ma med pa khyung chen gtsug gi nor bu lta bu'i man ngag gcig chod kyi gdams pa de nyid/ dus dang rkyen gyis skabs su 'phro lus rung / phyis su lung rtogs bon gyis phyug cing rig gnas lnga la ma rmongs shing mkhas pa'i nor la dbang pa'i drang srong nam mkha' tshul khrims kyis rab tu gus pa'i gsung shog yang yang 'byor ba dang / ma zad skye ba sngon nas tha dang dam tshig 'brel ba'i rigs mchog stag btsun dbang 'dus kyis dad mos lha rdzas dang bcas te bskul ba dang / dgos su rang rang gi lha srung gis gnang ba thob pa dang*/ yang dgos dam can gza' bdud chen pos dgyes tshul yang yang mdzad pa la brten nas/ deng sang snyigs dus kyi gdag byar gdung rgyud rgyal po drug gi nang nas rgod rje rgya bon rigs su grol ba'i bslab gsum lung rtogs kyi bon la blo kha phyogs pa'i tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dbang gi rgyal por 'bod pa bdag gis/ bon gyi 'dus gnas chen po dpal ldan nor bu gling du/ shing glang lo yi zla ba lnga pa'i tshes la grub par bgyis pa'o//
